query: A 16-year-old boy was caught with 500 grams of cannabis. What is the punishment?
gold_answer: Possession of small quantity of cannabis (NDPS 20) is punishable with 6 months to 1 year. As a juvenile, the Juvenile Justice Act would also apply alongside NDPS.

query: A person kidnapped a child and demanded ransom from parents
gold_answer: Kidnapping from lawful guardianship (IPC 363, 7 years) and kidnapping for ransom (IPC 364A, death or imprisonment for life).

query: A teacher sexually abused a 14-year-old student
gold_answer: Penetrative sexual assault of minor under POCSO Section 4, and sexual intercourse by person in authority IPC 376C.

query: A man used the name and signature of a deceased person to sell ancestral property
gold_answer: Forgery (IPC 463/467, up to life imprisonment for valuable security) and cheating (IPC 420, up to 7 years).

query: A gang of six men robbed a jewellery shop at gunpoint and tied up the employees
gold_answer: Dacoity (IPC 391/395, rigorous imprisonment for life) and dacoity with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt (IPC 397, minimum 7 years).

query: A builder sold the same flat to two different buyers using duplicate sale deeds
gold_answer: Cheating (IPC 420), forgery of a valuable security (IPC 467, life imprisonment or 10 years), and forgery for cheating (IPC 468, 7 years).

query: Ramesh is a doctor who got fake degree and practiced medicine, but a patient died under his medication
gold_answer: Multiple offences: death by negligent act (IPC 304A, up to 2 years), cheating by personation (IPC 416/419, up to 3 years), forgery (IPC 468, up to 7 years), cheating (IPC 420, up to 7 years).

query: A man drove drunk and hit a pedestrian who died. What crime has he committed?
gold_answer: Rash negligent driving causing death (IPC 304A, 2 years) and rash driving (IPC 279, 6 months).

query: A man attacked his neighbour with acid causing disfigurement
gold_answer: Acid attack causing grievous hurt (IPC 326A, minimum 10 years up to life) and attempt to throw acid (IPC 326B, minimum 5 years).

query: A middleman charged 40% commission to process a government subsidy for a farmer
gold_answer: Taking illegal gratification by public servant (PCA 8) and cheating (IPC 420) if misrepresentation involved.

query: A sub-inspector took 50,000 rupees bribe from a suspect to drop the FIR
gold_answer: Criminal misconduct by public servant under Prevention of Corruption Act Section 13, punishable with minimum 4 years (PCA 14).

query: A government contractor inflated bills and submitted them for payment — defrauding Rs 2 crores
gold_answer: Cheating (IPC 420) and criminal misconduct / financial fraud by a public servant (PCA 13) — both cognizable and triable by Sessions Court.

query: An employee was terminated without notice after reporting corruption by his manager to authorities
gold_answer: Whistleblower protection — though India lacks a comprehensive whistleblower statute for private sector, PCA Section 19 provides some procedural protection for complaints against public servants.

query: A police officer arrested Ravi without any reason and kept him in lockup for 5 days
gold_answer: Wrongful confinement for 3+ days (IPC 344, up to 2 years) and public servant disobeying law (IPC 166).

query: A husband beat his wife daily and his parents demanded more dowry
gold_answer: Cruelty by husband or relatives (IPC 498A, up to 3 years) and dowry death provisions (IPC 304B if death occurs).

query: A man sent obscene images to a woman repeatedly on WhatsApp without her consent
gold_answer: Sending obscene material via electronic means (ITA 66A, repealed but BNS successor applies) and insulting modesty of a woman (IPC 509).

query: A software engineer hacked into a bank system and transferred 10 lakhs to his account
gold_answer: Hacking/unauthorised access (ITA Section 66, up to 3 years) and cheating (IPC 420, up to 7 years).

query: A software developer uploaded a pirated movie on a server and charged users for access
gold_answer: Unauthorised download/sharing of copyrighted content (ITA 43 and 66) — civil and criminal liability. Copyright Act provisions also apply.

query: I signed a contract under threat and now want to cancel it. Can I?
gold_answer: Contract formed under coercion is voidable at the victim party option under ICA Section 19, read with Section 15.

query: My employer has not paid salary for three months. What can I do legally?
gold_answer: Failure to pay salary is a breach of the service contract (ICA 37). A civil money suit or labour court complaint is the remedy; IPC 403 may apply if funds were diverted.

query: Can a will be challenged in court by a brother who was excluded from inheritance?
gold_answer: A will can be challenged on grounds of lack of testamentary capacity (ICA 11), undue influence, or fraud. Proof of execution of the will is governed by IEA 68.

query: A landlord cut off water and electricity to force the tenant to vacate
gold_answer: Criminal trespass / wrongful eviction (IPC 441) and recovery of possession by dispossessed person (SRA Section 6).

query: Neighbour encroached on my land and built a wall on my plot. What are my legal options?
gold_answer: Criminal trespass (IPC 447); ownership protected under Transfer of Property Act; recovery of possession available under SRA Section 6.

query: A buyer paid full price for a flat but the developer disappeared without handing over possession
gold_answer: Cheating (IPC 420, up to 7 years) and specific performance suit under SRA Section 10 to compel delivery of possession.

query: My relative transferred property to me as a gift. What formalities are required for it to be valid?
gold_answer: A gift of immovable property must be made by a registered instrument signed by the donor and attested by two witnesses (TPA 123). TPA 122 defines gift.

query: My supplier gave me a cheque for 5 lakhs which bounced. What can I do?
gold_answer: Cheque dishonour is punishable under NI Act Section 138. NOTE: This act is not currently indexed in this RAG system.

query: Upper caste landlord refused to allow a Dalit worker entry to the village well
gold_answer: Atrocity under SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act Section 3 — denying access to public facilities based on caste is a cognizable offence.

query: What is the punishment for murder under Indian law?
gold_answer: Murder under IPC Section 302 is punishable with death or imprisonment for life, and fine. Equivalent provision in BNS is Section 103.

query: How do I file an anticipatory bail application? Which court do I approach?
gold_answer: Anticipatory bail under CrPC Section 438 / BNSS Section 482 is filed in the Sessions Court or High Court before arrest.

query: A person was held in custody for 90 days without being produced before a magistrate
gold_answer: Article 22 of the Constitution and CrPC 167 require production before magistrate within 24 hours. Continued detention without this is unconstitutional.

query: A person was detained without trial under a special security act for 18 months
gold_answer: Preventive detention under UAPA Section 19; must comply with Article 22 safeguards (maximum 3 months without Advisory Board review under ordinary detention laws, different under UAPA).

query: An accused person was denied access to a lawyer during police interrogation
gold_answer: Right to be represented by a legal practitioner (Article 22 of the Constitution); arrested person has right to consult lawyer under CrPC 41D.

query: What is culpable homicide not amounting to murder and how does it differ from murder?
gold_answer: IPC 299 defines culpable homicide; IPC 300 defines how it becomes murder. IPC 304 prescribes punishment (10 years to life) for culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

query: A school published the home address of a minor abuse survivor in their annual report
gold_answer: Disclosure of identity of a child victim is prohibited under POCSO Section 23 — punishable with fine or up to 6 months or both.
